title: Understanding the Mean Squared Error (MSE)
text: The Mean Squared Error (MSE) is a common measure used to evaluate the accuracy of a model. It is calculated as the average of the squares of the differences between the observed and predicted values.

title: Expressing MSE for this Model
text: For this problem, the MSE can be expressed as: MSE $$=$$ (1/n)*sum{i\=1}{n}{(y_i-f_theta(x_i))**2}.

title: Substitute the Model into MSE
text: Substitute the given model $$\operatorname{f_{\theta}}\left(x_i\right)=\theta e^{\sqrt{|x_i|}}$$ into the MSE expression.

title: Differentiate MSE with Respect to Theta
text: To find the optimal theta, differentiate the MSE with respect to theta and set the derivative equal to zero.

title: Solve for Theta
text: Solve the equation obtained from setting the derivative of MSE with respect to theta to zero.
